description: Known answer for the loka-cartridge-v2 content hash of cartridges/recipe_sampler (R5 S5; 05 §11; CartridgeArtifact.content_hash): one ActionRecipe (action.schema.json ActionRecipe: a detail target, an availability policy, a fact.assign then an event.emit, narration) in the optional recipes map, one instance bool fact, and two rooms whose description variants and one detail's show the rung bell; text with touch links. Assembled by hand from the source files (manifest without entry, the lock, empty actions, each room and the recipe with key added and short references expanded, entry, text), its canonical bytes by Python json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) and sha256 by hashlib, never by the kernels. For these values (small integers only, no control characters, three non-ASCII characters) Python's output is the loka-numeric-v1 encoding. R5 S6b (PM ruling on the owner's request that existing cartridges get the pools): the compiler adds resource@1 to requires and the lock and the default pools hp 0..20 start 20 gain 5, ma 0..100 start 100 gain 4 and mv 0..82 start 82 gain 18 (resource.schema.json ResourceSpec), added here by hand to the previous value. Review #49 A1 (PM ruling): the compiler also adds schedule@1 with the pools, so wait can regenerate an exhausted body; added here by hand to requires and the lock.

recipe_sampler@0.0.1:fact/chapel_bell_ru.meaning: The chapel bell was rung; the fen floods (00a §6, §10).

text.room.belfry.title: Belfry
text.room.belfry.description: The great [bronze bell](bell) hangs still from an oak beam. A frayed [rope](rope) drops from its wheel.
text.room.belfry.rung: The great [bronze bell](bell) still sways on its beam, humming. The [rope](rope) twitches against the wheel.
text.room.bell_tower.title: Bell Tower
text.room.bell_tower.description: A narrow stair climbs through the dark. Pigeon feathers drift on the steps.
text.room.bell_tower.rung: A narrow stair climbs through the dark. The walls still tremble with the bell's voice.
text.detail.bell: Green bronze, cold to the touch. No one has rung it in years.
text.detail.bell.rung: Green bronze, warm now, still humming under your hand.
text.detail.rope: Hemp rope, frayed where hands have pulled it.
text.narration.ring_bell.actor: You haul on the rope. The bell swings, and its voice rolls out over the fen.
text.narration.ring_bell.observers: The chapel bell rings out over the fen.
